signals.explanation: Servicer-system pull: 5 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 15 of 17 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 8 of 17 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
'Silverline Specialty Finance LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Credit LP': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings
Reported revenue is running 31% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
'Canyon Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Credit LP': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)
Covenant metric landed within 5% above the threshold two quarters running
3.4% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (43 of 1256)
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified

steps.title: Pause new advances against the affected collateral
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Pause new advances against the affected collateral
Case: B0097 · Finding: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender (medium confidence)
Action: Place a hold on further advances against the collateral named in the evidence until uniqueness is confirmed.
Based on:
  - 'Silverline Specialty Finance LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Credit LP': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed [ref S5-B0097-COMPETING_LIEN-762da725]
  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0097-DEBT_GAP-6b525801]

Due: 2026-09-12 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
